{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1xP5QH8a2bLfr9vjBbo","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01KVJFojnA6VtVAPaLQ4tUZx","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > /tmp/work/dispatch_check.py << 'EOF'\nimport csv, sys\nfrom collections import Counter, defaultdict\ncat_path, disp_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]\ndef num(s):\n    return float(s.strip().replace(',', '.'))\ncat = {}\nean = {}\nwith open(cat_path, newline='') as f:\n    for r in csv.DictReader(f):\n        r = {k: v.strip() for k, v in r.items()}\n        cat[r['product_id']] = r\n        ean[r['ean_code']] = r['product_id']\nprint(\"catalog products:\", len(cat), \"unique eans:\", len(ean))\ndisp = []\nwith open(disp_path, newline='') as f:\n    for r in csv.DictReader(f):\n        disp.append({k: v.strip() for k, v in r.items()})\nprint(\"dispatch rows:\", len(disp))\n# ids\nids = [d['dispatch_id'] for d in disp]\nprint(\"unique dispatch ids:\", len(set(ids)))\n# unmatched product ids\nfor d in disp:\n    if d['product_id'] not in cat:\n        print(\"UNMATCHED\", d, \"-> via EAN:\", ean.get(d['product_id']))\n# weight consistency\nfor d in disp:\n    pid = d['product_id'] if d['product_id'] in cat else ean.get(d['product_id'])\n    p = cat[pid]\n    q = int(d['quantity'])\n    w = float(d['total_weight_kg'])\n    exp = q * num(p['unit_weight_kg'])\n    if abs(exp - w) > 0.011:\n        print(\"WEIGHT MISMATCH\", d, \"expected\", round(exp, 3), p['name'])\n# months\nprint(Counter(d['timestamp'][:7] for d in disp))\n# duplicates on (timestamp, product, qty, weight)\nkey = Counter((d['timestamp'], d['product_id'], d['quantity'], d['total_weight_kg']) for d in disp)\ndups = {k: v for k, v in key.items() if v > 1}\nprint(\"duplicate keys:\", len(dups), \"extra rows:\", sum(v - 1 for v in dups.values()))\nprint(\"dup dates:\", sorted(Counter(k[0][:10] for k in dups).items()))\n# rows in 07-10..07-14 that are NOT duplicated\nfor d in disp:\n    if '2023-07-10' <= d['timestamp'][:10] <= '2023-07-14':\n        k = (d['timestamp'], d['product_id'], d['quantity'], d['total_weight_kg'])\n        if key[k] == 1:\n            print(\"non-dup in dup window:\", d)\n# same timestamp groups (not exact dups)\nts = defaultdict(list)\nfor d in disp:\n    ts[d['timestamp']].append(d)\nfor t, lst in ts.items():\n    if len(lst) > 1 and len(set((x['product_id'], x['quantity']) for x in lst)) > 1:\n        print(\"MULTI at\", t, [(x['dispatch_id'], x['product_id'], x['quantity']) for x in lst])\n# hour distribution\nprint(sorted(Counter(int(d['timestamp'][11:13]) for d in disp).items()))\n# quantity stats per category\nqs = defaultdict(list)\nfor d in disp:\n    pid = d['product_id'] if d['product_id'] in cat else ean.get(d['product_id'])\n    qs[cat[pid]['storage_category']].append(int(d['quantity']))\nfor c, l in qs.items():\n    print(c, len(l), min(l), max(l), sorted(l)[-5:])\nEOF\npython3 -I /tmp/work/dispatch_check.py /app/dataset/product_catalog.csv /app/dataset/warehouse_dispatches.csv","description":"Validate dispatch rows against catalog"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1632,"cache_read_input_tokens":37482,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1632,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"09281def-e610-4068-ab8b-3498e23987c6","uuid":"74ba43fb-1f2a-4469-bf09-4bc30de817ce","timestamp":"2026-10-14T10:17:49.427Z"}
